title: Uranium at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: a modern context on Skinwalker Ranch, they say that there's like a lot of uranium around.

plain: Skinwalker Ranch, a property in the American West famous for reports of strange happenings, is said to have a lot of uranium, a radioactive metal, in the ground around it. Michels repeats this as something "they say", without naming who. It comes up as a possible modern clue to why odd things are reported in some places, if such places really do share something in the earth.
